dedupe_keys.name: gnss rf recordings dataset from static antenna

description: Tampere University publishes radio-frequency recordings from a static rooftop GNSS antenna at the Tampere Wireless Research Center. The September 2024 deposit provides a ZIP archive under CC BY 4.0, free to download. Two documented recording events occurred on 30 November 2021 and 31 July 2024. An NI USRP-2953R receiver used a Spectracom GSG-6 external clock reference, centred on 1575.42 MHz. The description specifies eight-bit interleaved I/Q samples for one recording and eight-bit real samples at a ten-megahertz intermediate frequency for the other. These signals can calibrate GNSS receiver and observation models in simulations of positioning infrastructure. No related catalogue record explicitly covers them. The first filename suggests resampling to ten megahertz while its description states forty-megahertz sampling; that discrepancy must be resolved before decoding. Recording duration, antenna coordinates, interference conditions and uncertainty remain unknown. The binary payload was not opened.
